  1. Compute the Euclidean norm of the vector
  2. If the norm is 0 (zero vector), return the vector unchanged

```rust
use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;

#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn normalize(v: &[f32]) -> Vec<f32> {
    let norm = v.iter().map(|x| x * x).sum::<f32>().sqrt();
    if norm == 0.0 {
        v.to_vec()
    } else {
        v.iter().map(|x| x / norm).collect()
    }
}
```
